notes: Lifeguards need a current American Red Cross lifeguard card, plus CPR and First Aid. They must pass the water test. They must do this before the pool manager interview.
name: Aquatics Aide and Lifeguard (City pools)
what_you_do: Seasonal jobs at City swimming pools: aquatics aide or lifeguard. Lifeguards must pass a City water test first.
who_can_apply: The City page does not state a minimum age. The City's 2026 job fair listing says age 15 and up.
pay_detail: Paid. Wage not stated on the page.
deadline_text: The page lists no dates or deadlines.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form on the City job site. Then fill out the other forms: a background check, a liability form and a student work form. Anyone under 18 also fills out a drug test consent form. Call a pool to set up an interview with the pool manager. Lifeguards must first pass the City water test.
